name: Tengoku.Foundation.IsCompanion.extend_coe
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Foundation.IsCompanion.extend_coe (h : IsCompanion e a b) (x : A) :
    (h.extend ⟨x, le_closure_insert x.2⟩ : β) = e x

name: Tengoku.Foundation.IsCompanion.extend_self
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Foundation.IsCompanion.extend_self (h : IsCompanion e a b) :
    (h.extend ⟨a, self_mem_closure_insert⟩ : β) = b

name: Tengoku.Foundation.IsCompanion.extend_spec
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Foundation.IsCompanion.extend_spec (h : IsCompanion e a b)
    (x : (closure (insert a (A : Set α)) : BooleanSubalgebra α)) :
    ∃ y z : A, (x : α) = ((y : α) ⊓ a) ⊔ ((z : α) ⊓ aᶜ) ∧
      (h.extend x : β) = ((e y : β) ⊓ b) ⊔ ((e z : β) ⊓ bᶜ)

name: Tengoku.Foundation.exists_companionPiece
statement:
lemma Tengoku.Foundation.exists_companionPiece [DenselyOrdered β] (e : A ≃o B) (a : α) (p : A) :
    ∃ c : β, c ≤ (e p : β) ∧ (c = ⊥ ↔ (p : α) ⊓ a = ⊥) ∧ (c = (e p : β) ↔ (p : α) ≤ a)

name: FoundationFork.Finset.mem_imageOfFinset_iff

name: FoundationFork.Finset.sup_univ_equiv

name: FoundationFork.Part.mem_vector_mOfFn
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_vector_mOfFn : ∀ {n : ℕ} {w : List.Vector α n} {v : Fin n →. α},
    w ∈ List.Vector.mOfFn v ↔ ∀ i, w.get i ∈ v i
  |     0, _, _ => by simp [List.Vector.mOfFn, List.Vector.eq_nil]
  | n + 1, w, v => by
    suffices (∃ a ∈ v 0, ∃ u, (∀ (i : Fin n), u.get i ∈ v i.succ) ∧ w = a ::ᵥ u) ↔ ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), w.get i ∈ v i by
      simpa [List.Vector.mOfFn, @mem_vector_mOfFn _ n]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, v, hv, rfl⟩ i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [ha, hv]
    · intro h; exact ⟨w.head, by simpa using h 0, w.tail, fun i ↦ by simpa using h i.succ, by simp⟩
